svg.title: Starfall authored interface glyphs — concept specification
svg.desc: Twenty original 24-unit outline symbols and their visible gallery. One and a half unit strokes with rounded caps and joins. Native dimensions and accessibility have not been validated.
svg.text: 20 authored glyphs · 24-unit masters · 1.5-unit strokes · no imported icon library
Same visual weight. Distinct silhouettes. Labels carry the meaning.
Concept specification · illustration scale only · native touch targets, focus and contrast remain unverified.
